question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql:
SELECT p.name as product_name, pl.product_id, AVG(pl.qty) as avg_units_picked, COUNT(*) as num_picks, SUM(pl.qty) as total_units 
FROM picking_line pl 
JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id 
WHERE pl.order_id = 421 
GROUP BY pl.product_id, p.name 
ORDER BY pl.product_id

WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, line_no, location_id, qty as picked_qty
    FROM picking_line 
    WHERE order_id = 421
    ORDER BY product_id, line_no
),
ordered_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty as inv_qty, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.purchase_id) as inv_order
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM picking_line WHERE order_id = 421)
),
inventory_with_rank AS (
    SELECT *,
           SUM(inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, purchase_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as running_total
    FROM ordered_inventory
),
picked_cumulative AS (
    SELECT product_id, line_no, location_id, picked_qty,
           SUM(picked_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_picked
    FROM order_products
),
matched AS (
    SELECT inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.inv_qty, inv.purchased,
           COALESCE(
               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.picked_qty), 0) 
                FROM picked_cumulative m 
                WHERE m.product_id = inv.product_id 
                AND m.cum_picked <= inv.running_total),
               inv.inv_qty
           ) as matched_qty,
           COALESCE(
               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.picked_qty), 0) 
                FROM picked_cumulative m 
                WHERE m.product_id = inv.product_id 
                AND m.cum_picked < inv.running_total),
               0
           ) + inv.inv_qty as remaining_after_match
    FROM inventory_with_rank inv
    LEFT JOIN picked_cumulative pc ON pc.product_id = inv.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, purchase_id, matched_qty as qty_picked, purchased
FROM matched
WHERE matched_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, purchased, purchase_id
